identity_types.request_attempt: One source-issued attempt; retries remain separate attempts.
identity_types.logical_operation: Explicit source grouping or exact authored binding; no timestamp/name/argument inference.

identity_types.session_turn_busy_period: Distinct source session, observed turn and runtime busy-period identities.

identity_types.agent_delegation: Actual source role plus explicit parent/child and handoff IDs; acknowledgement is not acceptance.
identity_types.producer_epoch: Explicit process/producer epoch scopes counters and reset/restart interpretation.

privacy_rules: No prompts, reasoning, tool arguments/results, commands, error text, paths, memory contents, secrets or raw evidence in metrics.
Opaque project-scoped IDs only; no unsalted raw-content hashes as join keys.
No title, timestamp, text-similarity or latest-prompt joins.
Private evidence drilldown is explicit and separate from aggregate output.
No automatic history backfill, scheduled processing, private evaluations or live configuration changes.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Terminal events carry session identity, may cover coalesced drains, and do not carry prompt/turn/task identity.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep the busy period separate; never bind to the latest prompt or infer task completion.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Event payload persistence/replay is not guaranteed; captured events may be missed, dropped, or interrupted.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Show capture coverage unavailable without independent receipt/admission/emission/acknowledgement/ingestion counts; do not enable broad persistence to fill gaps.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Native metrics do not provide a general parent/child join or high-cardinality trace/session grouping.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Use bounded structural report joins only where explicit parent IDs are present; preserve unmatched, ambiguous and window-boundary counts.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Project-wide tool observations may come from integrations other than OpenCode.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Label native tool charts project-wide; call tools harness-linked only when an explicit supported ancestry link exists.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: A wrapper call does not prove which nested operations executed or provide their request/attempt identities.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep envelope and children separate; nested coverage unavailable until independent eligible-request counters and source parent IDs exist.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Title, compaction and other auxiliary generation purposes are not reliably classified by current observations.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Report purpose unknown unless explicitly supplied by the producer; do not infer from timing/name.

unsupported_correlations.source: Langfuse v2 totalCost and OpenCode generation cost
unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current cost values do not establish an independent split between provider-reported and locally inferred cost.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Keep one recorded cost measure with provider/currency caveats; mark the separate inferred-cost component explicitly unavailable.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current start and terminal events have distinct source event IDs and no verified stable compaction-operation ID for repeated operations in one session.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Count starts and terminal states separately; compaction duration is explicitly unavailable.

unsupported_correlations.limitation: Current trace IDs are deterministic domain-separated SHA-256 digests of source event/session/request IDs, but are not project-keyed.
unsupported_correlations.handling: Treat exported identities as legacy compatibility only; new v1.1 producers must use project-scoped opaque identifiers or a private keyed mapping.
